name: Strategic Investment
description: Covers major, proactive spending to fuel growth. Examples: Announcing a new factory, a multi-year R&D program, or a significant infrastructure upgrade.

name: Technological Breakthrough
description: A fundamental, game-changing innovation is announced or achieved. Examples: A new type of battery, a revolutionary AI model, a new drug discovery.

name: New Trend Adoption
description: Clear evidence that a new market trend, customer behavior, or product category is gaining significant traction and becoming mainstream.

name: Demand Slump / Trend Obsolescence
description: Clear evidence of falling customer demand, or a market trend becoming outdated or replaced by something new.

name: Geopolitical Tension
description: Negative international events. Examples: New tariffs, trade bans, international political instability, or conflicts affecting the market.

name: Geopolitical Cooperation
description: Positive international events. Examples: A new trade deal is signed, tariffs are lifted, or international standards are agreed upon.

name: Regulatory Headwind
description: Government or legal actions that negatively impact the business. Examples: An antitrust lawsuit, new compliance costs, or a product ban.

name: Regulatory Tailwind
description: Government or legal actions that positively impact the business. Examples: Deregulation, new industry subsidies, or winning a major patent lawsuit.

name: Supply Chain Boost
description: Positive, operational news about the supply chain. Examples: A key raw material becomes cheaper, a new efficient supplier is secured.

name: Supply Chain Disruption
description: Negative, operational news about the supply chain. Examples: A factory fire, a port strike, a key supplier going bankrupt.

name: Competitive Pressure
description: Actions by competitors that negatively impact the company. Examples: A rival launches a superior product, a price war begins.

name: Corporate Milestone
description: Significant positive company-specific news. Examples: Record-breaking profits, a highly successful product launch, major awards.

name: Corporate Setback
description: Significant negative company-specific news. Examples: A major product recall, poor earnings, a leadership crisis or scandal.

name: Security Event
description: News related to cybersecurity. Examples: A major data breach, a newly discovered vulnerability in a core product.

name: Mergers & Acquisitions
description: News about a company being acquired or merging with another major player. The impact can be positive or negative depending on the context.

name: Market Volatility
description: News that increases overall market uncertainty, without a clear positive or negative direction. Examples: Interest rate speculation, currency fluctuations.

name: Neutral/Noise
description: The news is relevant to the market but is not expected to have a material impact on the forecast.
